_note: Verdicts a person recorded after rendering each variant and looking at the turnaround and face sheet. Pass with --looked-at. Only PASS, CONCERNS and FAIL count; anything else leaves the criterion NOT ASSESSED. Re-judge after any change to the generator: a verdict against an old render is worth nothing, and the date is here so staleness is visible.
